name: @repo/worker-core
description: Shared, Workers-safe core for cloud workers: the WorkerDispatchAdapter port + its Fly implementation, normalized transcript event types, the worker params/callback wire schemas, and the callback-apply core. Pure, runtime-agnostic code — no Node built-ins, no app imports — so it bundles into both the Next.js dashboard and the Cloudflare Workers gateway. The Node-only LocalWorkerAdapter and the production factory stay in the dashboard app; the machine-side runner (apps/worker) deliberately duplicates the wire schemas instead of importing this package.
